stories.headline: Michigan Dem Haley Stevens endorses Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers
stories.description: US Rep Stevens lost Democratic primary to Abdul El-Sayed and now endorses his Republican opponent in the Senate race.

stories.headline: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
stories.description: Although exact numbers are not finalized, a sizeable chunk of its workforce will likely be cut.

stories.headline: Al Jazeera marks 30 years of transforming news in Middle East and beyond
stories.description: The anniversary coincides with a significant restructuring of Al Jazeera Media Network’s Arabic-language news services.

stories.headline: Russia detains minor over alleged Moscow attack plot after US warning
stories.description: Russian authorities say a US tip-off helped them identify teenager suspected of planning attack at a Moscow park.

stories.headline: Israel election: When will government be formed, who will lead it?
stories.description: President Herzog must tap candidate to form new government by November 11, with fraught negotiations likely to follow.
